admin.settings.subtitle: Everything that used to be edited by hand in config.php, secrets.php and config.txt. AI keys here are the shared defaults: a new person gets a copy in their account on sign-up.
admin.settings.env: set by environment variable {name} — editing here has no effect
admin.settings.pass_set: password is set; type a new one to change it
admin.settings.pass_none: no password — nobody can sign in to the admin
admin.settings.g.db_hint: Before saving the server tries to connect: if it fails, nothing changes.
admin.settings.g.paths_hint: Folders must exist, php-cli must run.
admin.settings.g.ai_conn_hint: Any OpenAI-compatible API. One active connection for everyone; a person with their own key in the account uses their own.
admin.settings.g.voice: Voice — dictation and reading replies aloud
admin.settings.g.voice_hint: Browser — free, no key: Chrome, Edge and Safari recognize speech and read replies themselves. OpenAI — live recognition and speech with the key below; the shared fields are copied to a new person at sign-up, after that they change them in their account.
admin.settings.g.ai_hint: Shared defaults: copied to a new person on sign-up, then they change them in their account.
admin.settings.f.name: Database name
admin.settings.f.tasks_autoclean: Scheme reset removes tasks of past runs
admin.settings.f.conn_timeout: Wait for the reply to start at most, seconds (5–600)
admin.settings.err_php: php-cli not found or does not run: {path}
admin.settings.err_url: {key}: the address must start with http:// or https://
admin.settings.err_ai_none: At least one connection is needed
admin.settings.err_ai_active: The active connection is not in the list
admin.settings.err_port: {key}: a port is a number from 1 to 65535
admin.settings.err_db: Could not connect to the database: {error}
admin.settings.err_write: Could not write {file}: check permissions on the project folder
admin.settings.g.lists_hint: Sections go in [brackets], a line is “key = Title | colour”. The key is stored in the database: don't change or remove it for an existing entry; the title can change. The text is checked before saving.
admin.settings.lists_problems: File not saved — fix these lines:
admin.settings.lp.no_section: Line {line}: entry comes before the first [section]
admin.settings.lp.no_equals: Line {line}: no “=” sign — neither an entry nor a section
admin.settings.lp.bad_key: Line {line}: key “{key}” — only Latin letters, digits, “_” and “-”
admin.settings.lp.duplicate: Line {line}: key “{key}” already exists in this section
admin.settings.removed_text: These will disappear from the file: {keys}. Schemes that refer to them will show an empty value.
admin.settings.f.agents_where: Where agents work: auto, local or remote
admin.settings.err_where: “Where agents work” is one of three: auto (by the server address), local (this computer), remote (their own computers)
admin.settings.where_remote: Now: web — agents on their own computers
admin.settings.where_local: Now: local — agents on this computer
admin.settings.g.guests_hint: A guest's project has no owner; once they sign in, the projects from their browser become theirs.
admin.settings.f.guest_days: Delete a guest project not opened for this many days (0 — never)
admin.settings.f.guest_ai: Paid AI for guests (assistant, builder, voice, Jev)
admin.settings.g.files_hint: Website only. By default materials stay on the person’s computer in the scheme folder; to the server — by a project checkbox, with these free-account limits. 0 means no limit.
admin.settings.f.files_limit_count: Files on the server per person
admin.settings.f.files_limit_kb: File size on the server, KB
admin.backup.title: Backup — download
admin.backup.about: Database — an SQL dump (.sql.gz): restore with gunzip < file | mariadb db_name. Files — a zip: materials, work folders, admin settings and config.txt. Keys and passwords (secrets.php) are not included — keep them separately.
admin.backup.no_zip: The server has no ZipArchive — nothing to build the file archive with
